name: Olivia / MFSK
description: Olivia, Contestia and MFSK keyboard chat inside Kainos, compatible with fldigi: every Olivia and Contestia tones / bandwidth from 4/125 to 64/2000, and MFSK4 to MFSK128L. Olivia reads signals well below the noise and finds a signal within 4 tones of where you click. Type to send, with F1 - F8 messages, and log the QSO.
author: Justin Cron K7JUS
